data_source: YouTube Data API v3 (search.list order=viewCount + videos.list statistics/contentDetails)

global_findings.hook_0_to_2s_rule: 85% of viewers decide to stay or swipe within 0.0s-1.8s. Scene 1 narration MUST be 5-8 words (1.6s-2.2s) accompanied by an immediate visual motion cut at 1.3s-1.5s.
global_findings.visual_deictic_anchoring: Million-view Shorts lock the viewer's eye at 0.0s using deictic pointers ('Look at this...', 'This man...', 'Watch the second...', 'Olha esse...', 'Esse lago...') paired with immediate physical motion on screen.
global_findings.zero_literary_fluff: Top 10M-120M view Shorts use Grade-5 conversational language (Zack D. Films / Factasm / Nature Lens / EiCurioso style), never slow poetic metaphors or textbook definitions.
global_findings.engagement_architecture: Because YouTube Data API v3 does not allow commenting on SCHEDULED (private) videos and has no API endpoint to pin comments, million-view pipelines embed a 1-vs-2 Poll/Debate Question in THREE places simultaneously: (1) Line 1 of Description, (2) Final Scene On-Screen Visual HUD Badge, and (3) Post-Premiere Automated Author Comment.

en-US.visual_cut_rhythm: Dual-beat fast cut in Scene 1 (Beat 1A: 0.0s-1.35s Shock Action -> Beat 1B: 1.35s-2.5s Close-up/Reaction), then 2.5s-3.8s per body scene.
hook_archetypes: Deictic Visual Shock: 'Look at this diver's suit at 1,000 feet.' / 'This man saved Earth from World War Three.'
Conversational Manipulation Trap (Psychology): 'If someone says "I'm just joking," watch their eyes.' / 'Turn any insult into instant respect with 3 words.'
Play-by-Play Apex Clash (Wildlife): 'This jaguar crushes caiman skulls with 1,500 PSI.' / 'Six adult lions backed down from one honey badger.'
Counterfactual Disaster Twist (History): 'In 1946, this underwater nuclear test went terribly wrong.'
Emotional Turning Point (Rescue): 'Watch the exact second this abandoned puppy felt safe.'
anti_patterns_causing_high_swipe: Abstract literary metaphors ('That sweet compliment is a loaded weapon', 'A word. A face. A sound.')
Slow 12-16 word opening sentences where the first visual cut happens after 3.5s
Rhetorical Yes/No questions ('Did you know...?', 'Have you ever wondered...?')

pt-BR.reading_grade_level: Coloquial Brasileiro Vibrante, Direto e Hiper-Visual
pt-BR.visual_cut_rhythm: Corte duplo rápido na Cena 1 (0.0s-1.35s Choque Físico -> 1.35s-2.5s Reação/Close-up), mantendo APV > 100%.
hook_archetypes: Confronto Direto + Número Físico (Vida Selvagem): '1.500 PSI: a onça perfura o crânio do jacaré!' / 'Nem o jacaré-açu encara um bando de ariranhas!'
Anomalia Extrema + Apontamento Visual (Mistérios): 'Esse lago no fundo do mar paralisa tubarões!' / 'A 93 graus, esse rio da Amazônia ferve tudo!'
Escala Absurda / Segredo Proibido: 'Essa é a verdadeira profundidade do oceano Pacífico!' / '260 naves espaciais afundaram nesse ponto secreto!'
anti_patterns_causing_high_swipe: Introduções lentas tipo documentário de TV ('O oceano é um lugar cheio de mistérios...')
Português de Portugal formal em vez de português brasileiro natural
Cena 1 com mais de 10 palavras sem número físico ou ação imediata
